_: Corrections applied on top of data/saints.json (src/lib/saints.ts). Wikidata has these wrong, incomplete or in an order that does not match the day a name is actually celebrated. Keep this list short and only for dates that are beyond dispute.

why.Q128267: Saint Joseph: the solemnity is 19 March; Wikidata only carries 1 May (Joseph the Worker).
why.Q9200: Paul the Apostle: Saints Peter and Paul, 29 June, is marked deprecated in Wikidata.
why.Q63070: Mary Magdalene: feast on 22 July; Wikidata lists it second.
why.carlos: Charles Borromeo (4 November) is the saint the name day follows, not Charlemagne.
why.teresa: Teresa of Ávila (15 October) is the saint the name day follows, ahead of Mother Teresa.
why.javier: Francis Xavier (3 December) is filed under Francisco because matching is by first name.
why.magdalena: Mary Magdalene is filed under María for the same reason.
